items.t: MongoDB Stock (MDB): Wells Fargo Says Buy Ahead of Earnings After Positive Customer Survey
items.sum: U.S. database provider MongoDB (MDB) is preparing to release its fiscal Q3 2027 earnings next Tuesday, December 1, after market close. Ahead of the results, Ryan MacWilliams, a five-star analyst at Wells Fargo (WFC), has assigned a Buy rating on MDB stock. He set a $475 price target, predicting about 52% upside. items.t: Opvizor Launches AI-Powered Database Monitoring and Diagnostics to Optimize MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQL Server
items.sum: HOUSTON, November 24, 2026--Opvizor, a division of Codenotary Inc., today announced the launch of dbfrog, an AI-powered database monitoring and optimization platform for Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis.
